headlines.title: Trump took a secret flight out of Turkey in an elaborate plot to hide his location amid Iran war
headlines.description: President Donald Trump was whisked out of Turkey last month on a military aircraft in an elaborate plot to keep his location secret amid security fears from the war with neighboring Iran, according to a U.S. official with knowledge of the plan.

headlines.title: Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs chooses former Republican as running mate in re-election bid
headlines.description: Arizona’s Democratic Gov. Katie Hobbs has chosen a former Republican as her running mate for her re-election bid this November.

headlines.title: Lauren Boebert’s 21-year-old son is arrested on child sexual exploitation charges
headlines.description: The allegations are linked to a video Tyler Boebert, then 18, is accused of recording in 2024 with a 17-year-old.

headlines.title: Trump Signs Executive Order on Childhood Vaccine Schedule
headlines.description: President Donald Trump has issued a new executive order calling for an overhaul of the childhood vaccine schedule that would reduce the number of vaccines kids receive, citing unsubstantiated claims. Critics are blasting the move, saying misinformation could mislead parents. NBC’s Nikki Battiste reports and NBC medical contributor Dr. John Torres joins TODAY with analysis.

headlines.title: Trump Secretly Switched Planes in Turkey Amid Reported Threat
headlines.description: Following the NATO summit in Turkey in July, President Donald Trump was seen boarding a decoy Air Force One. The Washington Post reports that after boarding the plane, he was whisked away to a nearby aircraft using a catering truck. The ruse was reportedly used to conceal his whereabouts amid an ongoing assassination threat from Iran. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: All Eyes on Key Midterm Primaries in Wisconsin and Minnesota
headlines.description: Voters are heading to the polls in another round of competitive primary races in the build-up to November’s midterm elections. In Wisconsin and Minnesota, Democrats will once again decide between moderate and progressive candidates. Meanwhile, in South Carolina, Republicans will pick a replacement nominee for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Jennifer Balkcom picked to replace Rep. Chuck Edwards in N.C. congressional race
headlines.description: Edwards dropped his re-election bid after the House Ethics Committee recommended he be censured over sexual harassment allegations. He has denied any wrongdoing.

headlines.title: Trump order aims to cut number of diseases all children should be vaccinated against from 18 to 11
headlines.description: The order reaffirms the dramatic overhaul to the vaccine schedule that Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced this year. Those changes have been blocked in court.

headlines.title: Recount puts Trump-backed challenger in the lead in Indiana state Senate primary
headlines.description: State Sen. Spencer Deery, who now trails Republican Paula Copenhaver by three votes, said he will appeal.

headlines.title: As Francesca Hong surged, Democratic rivals held their fire: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, we take a look at the lack of attacks Francesca Hong has faced on the Wisconsin airwaves. Plus, Allan Smith dives into an unexpected bipartisan pairing in Pennsylvania.

headlines.title: RFK Jr. wants to fix loophole that allows additives into food. Critics say it doesn’t go far enough.
headlines.description: The Trump administration said it’s taking first steps in strengthening rules over ingredients food companies have long added to their products with minimal oversight.
